data.name: Settings_WhisperIsFreeSpeechRecognitionThatRunsOnYourComp
data.value: Whisper is free speech recognition that runs on your computer and is usually far more accurate with accents than the Windows one. Download a model (a .bin file) into the Whisper folder, then click Refresh. Names ending in .en, like ggml-base.en.bin, are English only; the others are multilingual. The base and small models are a good balance of speed and accuracy.
